<DOCSTRING>
Binds user input to create a new schedule.

Args:
    schedule_name (str): The name of the schedule.
    message (str): The message to be sent.
    receiver (str): The receiving phone number.
    hours (str): The hour in hh:mm format.
    minutes (str): The minute in hh:mm format.

Returns:
    None: The function creates a new schedule and prints a confirmation message.
Raises:
    None: No explicit raise statements found.
</DOCSTRING>
